title: A little disappointed
text: A little disappointed. Smaller than I thought it would be. Excellent for a kid or teen, but not an adult as far as I am concerned.

product_metadata.title: ComfortCloud Reading Pillow Bed Wedge Large Adult Backrest Lounge Cushion w/Arms Pockets Lumbar Back Support for Sitting Up GERD Heartburn Made in The USA w/Stain Resistant Removable Cover
features: DELUXE READING PILLOW – ComfortCloud plush shredded foam reading pillows conform perfectly to all body types for optimal back alignment while relaxing upright. Removable, washable cover features BONUS storage located in the arm side pockets for your phone, glasses, book, tablet, or remote.

BED WEDGE – The ComfortCloud backrest is shipped compressed. Simply remove the wrapping; loosen the shredded foam by shaking vigorously for 5 minutes, or by placing it in the dryer (NO heat) with two clean tennis balls for 5 minutes. Allow 24-48 hours for pillow to fully expand; pillow measures 18 inches high by 15 inches wide, providing firm ample back support.

VERSATILE COMFORT – The ComfortCloud lounge cushion provides comfortable back support for sitting up in bed while reading a good book, watching TV, or surfing the internet. Features medical grade material for those on bedrest , suffering from GERD or heartburn. Use as a wedge to elevate your upper body to help you stay more comfortable while at rest or sleep.

EASY CARE STAIN RESISTANT – ComfortCloud pillows feature a warm blue breathable velour cover that can easily be spot cleaned with a damp cloth. For full cleaning, the ComfortCloud reading pillow features a removable, machine washable cover. Featuring anti-clump shredded foam padding for a lifetime of soft comfort-ability. The attached fabric handle makes it easy to carry your pillow with you from room to room.

GUARANTEE – We want you to completely satisfied with your ComfortCloud reading pillow. We have a no hassle 100% guarantee refund policy. If you use your ComfortCloud Reading Pillow and do not love it, simply return for a full refund, even used. Add one to your cart today.
